variants.design: PORCELAIN WINDOW. A broad nearly flat porcelain-white center occupies 62% of width, with modest cool silver shading only close to its edges; the central 40% stays visibly solid near-white, not a giant diffuse glow. Deep almost-black graphite recessed gutters around the center occupy 7% each. Outer shoulders are neutral medium silver with a tiny white polished outer edge. Strong broad white versus narrow deep-black separation. White #F4F5F2, graphite #151B23, cool silver #78858F. Smooth ceramic and polished steel. No blue wash.

TWO ivory-white solid rails, each around 8% width, are near x=15% and x=85%; they must be wide legible white bands, not tiny hairlines. Outer side strips are graphite with thin silver chamfers. variants.design: SILVER CENTRAL SPINE. Change the luminance structure radically: a SINGLE broad white-silver vertical band centered at x=50%, spanning 24% of total width. On either side, broad dark slate planes, about 28% width each, colored #27313E with simple beveled shading. Outside these sit tiny near-black gutters and narrow satin silver outer rails. The silver spine is visibly one continuous flat band with a narrow polished chamfer, not two bands, no central groove. White-silver #EAF0F1, slate #27313E, ink #090E15. Low chroma neutral, darker overall than porcelain.

variants.title: 청회색 유리 · 흰 안쪽 테두리
variants.description: 중간 밝기의 청회색 면에 흰 테두리와 검은 홈을 더합니다.
variants.design: SMOKED BLUE GRAY GLASS. A 56%-wide flat smoked-glass middle plane in muted steel blue #58717E, with restrained lighter center #8297A0, clearly MEDIUM luminance rather than near-white or near-black. Along its immediate sides run two very crisp white light strips, 3% width each. Outside them are broad near-black blue-gray recessed grooves #141F28, about 10% width each. Satin slate outer shoulders with an angled chrome edge. The color is visibly a subtle blue-gray rather than saturated blue. White pinstripes frame a broad mid-value glass panel. Rich tactile depth without texture noise.

variants.title: 웜그레이 · 크림색 어깨

variants.design: WARM GRAPHITE WITH CREAM SHOULDERS. A 42%-wide central flat smoked warm-gray metal field #514A40, subtle center highlight #776F61. Two almost-black recessed trenches #201D19, 5% width each, directly border the central field. Broad ivory/champagne-white shoulders occupy about 15% width each near x=17% and x=83%; outermost strips are dark bronze-gray with tiny pale metal edges. Overall low chroma, ivory #EDE4CF versus deep espresso graphite, NOT saturated yellow or gold. Warm but mostly gray. Broad cream shoulders, narrower dark center and grooves, clearly different from the two narrow-line variants.
